title: NothingOS 2.6(Pong-U2.6-241016-1700)
description:
What's new in this update

General improvements and bug fixes
🎮 PUBG now supports a high refresh rate of 90fps for smoother gameplay!
📶 Expanded support for VoLTE and VoWiFi across more carriers.
🔄 Fixed system lag when rapidly switching the network tile in Quick Settings.
🛡️ Update security patch to October.
🧰 Enhanced system stability.
